title: Jadarian Price, Notre Dame's No. 2 running back, may be NFL draft's second-best RB

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jadarian Price, Notre Dame's No. 2 running back, may be NFL draft's second-best RB
sources.description: At Notre Dame, Jadarian Price took a backseat to Jeremiyah Love. In the NFL draft, he might be the second-best RB – behind only Love.
